route_status.proven_scope: The unchanged probe_passive ran once on Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf with an isolated save profile and exited 0. It checked the idle critter book; directly launched each of five friend activities and observed zero-input 60-sim-second intervals; checked selected shop, slide, fairy, Toy Castle, companion-care and ambient-water agency assertions; checked Day One required snapshot keys and mutation detection for 26 Chapter Two fields. Retained log ends PASSIVE|result: ALL OK.
route_status.route_gaps: This is a mixed-route internal probe, not an ordinary fresh-save child route. The five friend activities are launched with main._start_game(f), and some terminal states/inputs are set directly in the special agency checks. The test does not prove how a child reaches or understands those activities, see their Mobile-rendered response, or handles untested game modes. MA-CI-005 remains CONFIRMED_OPEN: central passive coverage and serialized reward-surface coverage still need reconciliation across all modes. MA-PLAY-005 remains a separate Chapter Two reachability blocker. No physical touch, target-device, child, or owner evidence was produced.

play_appeal.agency: Hypothesis: idle boundaries that keep progress unchanged while leaving a clear, available next action can protect agency without punishing a child who pauses. This probe verifies selected state assertions, not whether the action is apparent.
play_appeal.variety: The harness samples five different friend activities plus shop, slide, fairy, Toy Castle and care gates, but it does not compare the felt variety of their actions or presentation.
play_appeal.world_response: The log confirms idle unrewarded states and selected gates. Headless execution does not show whether characters, world objects, sound, and progress cues make waiting versus acting legible.
play_appeal.replay: Whether the child voluntarily resumes or replays after a pause is unknown.
play_appeal.appeal_test: On the Lenovo Tab M11 with an isolated test save and the exact candidate build, start one reachable activity through its ordinary visible route. Without explaining the controls, invite the child to watch quietly for 60 seconds, then ask only 'What can Roshan do now?' Record whether any reward appears while idle, whether the child identifies and performs a deliberate action, acknowledgment latency, and any adult prompting. Repeat with one contrasting reachable activity, then let the child pause/leave and choose whether to return or replay; record that choice and any confusion. Verify save/progress before and after in the adult test profile. This is a proposed test, not observed evidence.

observations.title: Five directly launched friend games remain active and unrewarded through the 60-second idle assertion
evidence: audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L51/attempt_1/probe.log: Evie and Lamb-a' [seek], Harper and Fiona [slide], Faron [dolls], Daddy Mermaid [melody], Wacky and Chuck [fetch] each report active and unrewarded at 60s; result ALL OK
observations.reproduction: Run the retained L51 receipt command once in an isolated profile; the five PASSIVE rows show all five activities pass the no-win/no-progress/save-change assertions.
observations.child_impact: This run supports the no-passive-win invariant for these five tested activity states; it does not prove child access or comprehension.
observations.proposed_repair: None indicated by this focused run.
observations.acceptance_test: Keep the zero-input leg fail-closed: assert no win, serialized progress change, save mutation, or premature activity exit at the 60.0-second simulated boundary for each covered activity.

observations.title: Coverage is strong for selected serialized fields, but the live finding still identifies unclosed cross-mode idle coverage
evidence: audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L51/attempt_1/probe.log: Chapter Two snapshot mutation OK all 26 fields; Day One snapshot contract OK
observations.reproduction: Inspect _progress_snapshot and the probe's named idle modes, then compare them with MA-CI-005's remaining Opera/combat/castle/Family Evening acceptance gap. The current PASS does not close that finding.
observations.child_impact: An untested reward-bearing activity could accidentally award progress during waiting without this central probe detecting it.
observations.proposed_repair: Continue the MA-CI-005 inventory: for every reward-bearing mode, include its serialized surfaces in the passive snapshot or add a dedicated idle/no-award leg and mutation check.
observations.acceptance_test: At the exact head, enumerate serialized reward fields and reward-bearing modes; deliberately mutate each newly covered field under idle input and require the probe to fail, while all mode-specific idle checks remain green.

observations.title: Friend activity entry is direct fixture setup, so the probe does not demonstrate a child's route
evidence: audit/findings/ACTIVE_FINDINGS_2026-08-13.md:973-1007 (MA-PLAY-005 remains CONFIRMED_OPEN for Chapter Two career reachability)
observations.reproduction: Observe the probe calling main._start_game(f) for each friend activity and directly parking player state; no visible selection, navigation, or child instruction occurs.
observations.child_impact: A correct idle invariant inside a mode cannot assure the child can discover that mode or reach it from the normal save route.
observations.proposed_repair: No repair is proposed to this negative test for its stated scope; evaluate live reachability in the dedicated route review and retain the separate MA-PLAY-005 blocker.
observations.acceptance_test: On a fresh save, use the ordinary visible route to reach the relevant career with no spoken control coaching, then separately run its idle and intentional-action checks; report route and no-award claims independently.

observations.title: Selected special gates distinguish idle or held input from a fresh deliberate action
evidence: audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L51/attempt_1/probe.log: Pearl Shop, Penguin Slide, Fairy, and Toy Castle agency rows report OK
observations.reproduction: The probe supplies no input at passive terminal gates, holds action_down across the fairy release gate, and checks a distinct steered/fresh-press path for progress; retained output reports those assertions OK.
observations.child_impact: In these tested states, idle/held input does not silently award the selected reward, while the probe recognizes distinct intentional paths. The visible cue and physical touch feel remain unknown.
observations.proposed_repair: None indicated by the selected assertions.
observations.acceptance_test: On the exact build, retain passive, held-through-gate, release, and fresh intentional-action cases; verify rewards occur only on the required new action and remain absent on idle/held controls.

observations.title: Headless PASS does not measure visible response, phone pacing, or non-reader appeal
observations.reproduction: The helper receipt explicitly marks the run headless and says it is not rendered Mobile acceptance; the tested intervals are process/simulation assertions without target geometry or child observation.
observations.child_impact: The probe cannot tell whether a child notices the available action, sees an acknowledgment, or finds the idle-versus-play boundary inviting and understandable.
observations.proposed_repair: No code repair is inferred. Capture and observe a bounded ordinary route on the target device after a candidate is available, keeping the machine no-award assertion as its own lane.
observations.acceptance_test: On the exact candidate APK and Lenovo Tab M11, record input-to-visible response and frame pacing, then observe a child through a quiet wait, a deliberate action, and a voluntary return/replay without coaching; keep missing evidence explicitly pending.
